message_text: I just submitted my application! How long until I hear back?
Congratulations on submitting! You'll receive a confirmation email within 24 hours. Admission decisions are typically sent within 4-6 weeks.
Is there anything else I need to do?
Make sure to: 1) Send official transcripts, 2) Submit SAT/ACT scores if not already sent, 3) Check your applicant portal regularly for any requested documents.
All done already! The application process was actually really smooth.
Wonderful! We're glad to hear that. We'll be in touch soon. Good luck!
